tool_args.rationale: A gradient-attenuated rational term plus a separately attenuated square-root term reproduces all seven paid observations to reported precision. The branch measurements constrain gradient dependence, and all rows are already at the target horizon H=0.6. Submit the fitted law for fresh confirmation without another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The branch measurements show a strong gradient effect that input-only saturation cannot explain.

considered_alternatives.option: Sum of two rational saturation terms
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It leaves systematic residuals on the fixed-gradient pilot rows; the square-root second term fits all seven rows to their reported precision.
The existing gradient contrasts already support a five-parameter law at the requested horizon. Fresh confirmation is the next useful test.
